description.en: SciDocBench evaluates scientific document understanding with 124 expert-authored questions across seven capability groups and 19 subtasks in five scientific domains. Each question is tested under four conditions (English vs Chinese and all-images-first vs interleaved), yielding 496 instances. Performance is reported on a 100-point scale. Data and pipeline are released via a public repository.

claire_radar.whyItMatters: Existing benchmarks address scientific document understanding in isolated tasks, not realistic research workflows combining text, equations, figures, and cross-references. SciDocBench provides a structured evaluation, shows that strong systems remain limited, and connects diagnostics to scalable training data for scientific assistants.
